visual_enhancers.pcb_trace_pattern: Use raw SVG lines with 90-degree and 45-degree angled paths. Set stroke to 'rgba(10,132,255,0.35)' (or a linear gradient from transparent to #0A84FF). Add small filled circles (r='3' fill='#00A3FF') at the joints. Animate the 'pathLength' from 0 to 1 with Framer Motion on scroll.

header.style: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0E1116]/80 border-b border-[#0A84FF]/20 py-4
header.behavior: Mobile hamburger uses a standard slide-down or full-screen overlay menu. Links must scroll to anchors.

component_patterns.logo_recreation: Recreate strictly in SVG/JSX: Flex container. Text 'ПК' in white bold. Text 'ТУТ' in #0A84FF, surrounded by a rounded rectangle (border-2 border-[#0A84FF] rounded-md px-1 ml-1 drop-shadow-[0_0_5px_rgba(10,132,255,0.8)]).

grids_and_layouts.container: w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8
grids_and_layouts.hero_layout: grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-12 items-center min-h-[85vh] pt-32
grids_and_layouts.benefits_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6. Make the first and last cards col-span-1 md:col-span-2 or similar asymmetrical bento treatment to avoid boring symmetry.
grids_and_layouts.process_4_step: Relative positioning. Grid cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-8. Background absolute SVG for PCB connecting line traversing through the 4 steps.

stagger_children.child: variants={{ hidden: { opacity: 0, y: 20 }, show: { opacity: 1, y: 0 } }}

motion.pcb_line_draw: variants={{ hidden: { pathLength: 0 }, visible: { pathLength: 1, transition: { duration: 1.5, ease: 'easeInOut' } } }}

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against #0E1116 meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio. The secondary text #B7C0CC passes against #0E1116.
accessibility.focus_states: All inputs and buttons must have visible focus rings using focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-[#0A84FF] focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-[#0E1116].
accessibility.forms: Include aria-labels for all form fields and error states if invalid.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all text is in Russian per the problem statement requirements.
Implement a hidden /admin route accessible only via a token 'X-Admin-Token' input. Build a dashboard with a dark on-brand theme and a data table for leads (with status toggles).
For the Lead Form (#zayavka), implement a +7 phone mask and a select dropdown with specific choices: сборка ПК, апгрейд, диагностика, чистка, установка Windows, консультация.
Integrate a Yandex Map iframe for the #kontakty section.
Use lucide-react for all iconography (services, benefits, micro-interactions).
Use Framer Motion to create a unified scrolling experience, paying specific attention to the PCB-trace SVG line in the 'Как мы работаем' section.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not use generic centered layouts. Leverage asymmetry, Bento grids, and off-center alignments.
Ensure generous spacing; apply 2-3x more padding than usual.
No purple AI-slop gradients. Stick purely to the defined #0E1116 graphite background and #0A84FF neon cyan/blue accent structure.
All interactive elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing (e.g., data-testid='submit-lead-button').
Never use pure transparent backgrounds over content for Headers; strictly use the defined glassmorphism.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, links, inputs, and interactive map/form elements.
